cc END and rerun READY. END of 01M8C48X37NEK2V17X9FVVQF90, released at 14:39:36Z: RED. Leg 1 at bfae06a2: plan 1..216, ran 216, not ok 2, skipped 0, 283 s (save/runs/fix-response-20261126T143353Z.tap). Leg 2 over 9af5e8f3: plan 1..18, ran 18, not ok 17, skipped 0; every arm red but the named GREEN_AT_BASE, which passed (save/runs/base-round-20261126T143353Z.tap).

Fix: new tip 55616645. git diff --stat bfae06a2 55616645 gives plan.lua (2 +-), arngz.bats (+20) and fixtures/fake-hs (6 ++--): 3 files, 25 insertions, 3 deletions. (1) AT-03.2: plan.lua:571's comment says "Hammerspoon's JSON writer". The guard's own pattern now finds no line in plan.lua, and this round added no other "hs." there. (2) AT-03.1's hang arm: by reading, the late writer is the end mark's call, which the CLI draws with WAIT 0 at its exit. The hung ask is not the writer: the CLI stops it itself (arngz:1160 to 1170: kill after the timeout and HS_EXIT_MARGIN, then wait). Every marked arm shares the race, so the fix is once, in arngz.bats: a suite teardown() waits up to 5 s for every fake from the test's fakebin to exit, stops any still running, then calls utilz_teardown. It calls /usr/bin/pgrep and /usr/bin/pkill by path, because fake-macos's pgrep is first on PATH in some arms. fake-hs's hang modes use exec -a "$0", so a hung ask keeps the fakebin path in its name and teardown can see it. Nothing changes in test_helper.bash.

Driver ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/save/run-rerun.sh, sha256 d00b608f688f1925be5b9ffa0e03d998422cd15b92ec0c50b6c6ca432870d682. Leg 1 runs arngz.bats whole at 55616645. Leg 2 is the proof by a forced order. The planted patch save/proof/planted-late-end-mark.patch (sha256 48872210afaa50f695d3a6d8020b7eaa8b8676c05f858a0926fc4824fa428f3a, never committed) makes an end mark's fake call write 2 s late and say in PROOF_LOG whether hslog was still there. It goes into two scratch worktrees, each running the hang arm alone. At bfae06a2 the line must be "late end mark: hslog was gone" (red: teardown removed the dir under the late call). At 55616645 it must be "late end mark: written into hslog" (green: teardown waited). Any other line, or none, refuses. Caps are 1200 s for leg 1 and 120 s for each proof leg.

dc's XS is not in it: dc's board says I4cbec17 waits for hv to pick route A or A+B. ic reads the test change, since fake-hs and the teardown serve the marks arms. On your word I ask the Desk for one light slot that names the driver and the patch.
